title: Counter-Tune the Fork
prompt: Match the repeating cutter pulse before the cold loop overheats.
success_message: The cutter, suit ground, and operator loop lock into phase.
failure_hint: The signals beat against each other and the cold loop climbs. Adjust the sweep, coolant, and ground phase.

title: Harmonic Choir Lock
prompt: Bring Nova's heartbeat to a resting pace, ease the pressure, and turn her signal until it leaves room for the other voices. The readouts show which way to adjust.
success_message: The Chorus keeps its separate voices and turns with Nova instead of against her.
failure_hint: The voices still crowd each other. Check which controls are outside their range, then try again.

title: Calibrate Bioluminescent Prism
prompt: Aim the beam into the receiver, tighten its fringe, then balance the glow. A steady green receiver means the lattice is ready.
success_message: The crystal lattice illuminates with resonant green light, revealing an ancient focus component.
failure_hint: Center the beam, tighten the fringe, and keep the receiver green rather than dim or overloaded.

title: Synchronize Chrono Coils
prompt: Steady the coil before it drops the signal. Damping cuts the jitter, pitch brings the carrier into range, and dilation lines up the return pulse.
success_message: The tachyon loop locks into crystalline harmony, expelling an overclocked core.
failure_hint: The coil dropped the signal. Use the readouts to bring each control into range.

title: Forge Test Chamber
prompt: Assign a safeguard to each beat of the recorded cycle. The simulation won't move the live machinery.
failure_hint: Review the highlighted beats, then run the test again.

title: Balance Magma Conduit
prompt: Bleed heat before the conduit bursts, thin the slag so it can flow, and turn the pressure seal until it seats.
success_message: Pressure stabilizes with a heavy hiss, releasing a pristine thermal armor plate.
failure_hint: The cradle is still under pressure. Bring any out-of-range controls back toward their operating range.

title: Phase-Lock Graviton Well
prompt: Bring the well's spin, field frequency, and dampener into range so the field stops twisting the vault.
success_message: Gravity normalizes with a deep hum, unsealing the graviton inertia matrix.
failure_hint: The field still pulls off-axis. Check the control readouts before trying again.
